## Introduction
This report summarize data collected in REDCap for PAN Project 2.

## Report Frequency
This report is ran once a month, currently I run it the first Monday of every month. 

## Connecting to database
In the first line of this second chunk, you’ll see code that establishes the database connection. The connection uses credentials stored as environment variables in a local .Renviron file rather than hard-coding them in the script. To run this code as written, you’ll need to create a .Renviron file on your machine with the same variables. The credentials are then accessed via Sys.getenv() as shown below:

```
con <- dbConnect(
  RPostgres::Postgres(),
  host        = Sys.getenv("host"),
  user        = Sys.getenv("user"),
  password    = Sys.getenv("password"),
  dbname      = Sys.getenv("dbname"),
  sslmode     = Sys.getenv("sslmode"),
  sslrootcert = "rds-ca-2019-root (2).pem"
)
```
